notes.title: T-REX UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hello! It has been one year since Dinogotchi release! And i'm very happy to announce that the game is going to get some content updates with new things and improvements.

The first one is the [b]T-Rex Update[/b]. As the name suggests, this update features T-Rex as a new dinosaur ːsteamhappyː. And there is also lots of new additions to the game! Here follows an list with everything new:

[list]
[*] T-Rex evolution line with 5 new dinosaurs:
[list]
[*] Guanlong
[*] Gorgosaurus
[*] T-Rex
[*] Albertosaurus
[*] Tarbosaurus
[/list]
[*] 3 new food items for your dinos
[*] Shop screen improved
[*] Some reworks on the game art, such as Spinosaurus and Megalosaurus main game arts
[*] A new enemy added on the garden defense minigame
[/list]
